title: Use a state-uniform extraction event to transfer to actual later memory
statement: For the acquired exact on-site product receiver, virtual global Bell failure is 1-product_i(1-ell_i)<=sum_i ell_i<=9epsilon/32, independent of gauge state. A record-defined good event and calibration-record TV debit therefore remain valid after imperfect calibration changes future memory. One future complete service adds its own norm debit; the comparator uses the actual later memory, not a counterfactual oracle history.
